ORDINANCE XXXI OF 1984
ORDINANCE XXXI OF 1984
PRESIDENT'S PENSION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1984
An Ordinance further to amend the President's Pension Act, 1974
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 29th July, 1984]
No. F. 17(1)/84-Pub.-The
following Ordinance, made by the President, is hereby published for general
information :-
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called
the President's Pension (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on the first day of July, 1983,

Amendment of section 2, Act IX of 1975

ORDINANCE XXXI OF 1984
ORDINANCE XXXI OF 1984
PRESIDENT'S PENSION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1984
An Ordinance further to amend the President's Pension Act, 1974
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 29th July, 1984]
No. F. 17(1)/84-Pub.-The
following Ordinance, made by the President, is hereby published for general
information :-
2. Amendment of section 2, Act IX of 1975.--In the President's
Pension Act, 1974 (IX of 1975), in section 2,-
(a) in
subsection (1), for the wordy "four thousand and five hundred rupees"
the words "five thousand rupees" shall be substituted; and
(b) in
subsection (2),-
(i) for the
words "fifty thousand rupees" the words "fifty-six thousand
rupees" shall be substituted; and
(ii) for the
words "two lakhs and fifty thousand rupees" the words "two lakhs
and eighty thousand rupees" shall be substituted.
